sections.heading: Medical Services for International Travelers
body: 24/7 Clinic provides urgent and primary medical care through a network of clinics located directly inside hotels and resorts. Many common medical conditions can be assessed and treated on-site, reducing unnecessary hospital visits and helping travelers receive care quickly and conveniently.

items.title: Urgent Care
items.text: Fever, Respiratory infections, Gastrointestinal illness, Dehydration, Allergic reactions, Pain, Ear infections, Minor infections, Other acute medical conditions

items.title: Minor Injuries & Procedures
items.text: Wound care, Burns, Minor trauma, Sprains, Dressings, Suturing, Follow-up care

items.title: Diagnostics
items.text: Medical examination, Laboratory testing, Basic diagnostic services, Referral for advanced diagnostics when required

items.title: Medication & IV Treatment
items.text: Doctor-prescribed medication, Injections, IV therapy when clinically indicated

items.title: Specialist Care
items.text: Access to specialist physicians and referral where medically required.

items.title: Hotel Room Visits
items.text: Doctor attendance may be arranged in the patient’s hotel room depending on location and medical condition.

items.title: Dental Care
items.text: Keep existing dental services as a secondary service category.

devNotes: The page should focus first on urgent care and traveler medical needs.
Beauty & Wellness may remain as a secondary service but should no longer define the main medical positioning of the website.
